Congratulations to the students from James Clemens High School and the Alabama School of Fine Arts on representing our great state at the National Science Bowl Finals. Good luck!


DOE Office of Science (@doescience)

The National Science Bowl prepares today’s STEM students to be the scientists and engineers of the future. Tune in to watch the showdown between the top two middle and high school teams on Monday, May 4: science.osti.gov/wdts/nsb/20…

We must put safeguards in place to prevent AI companions from engaging minors in harmful and potentially life-threatening behavior. 

We can’t just talk about these tragedies, we have to take action—today we did by advancing the GUARD Act out of committee.

If you’re not familiar with Biden’s 1071 rule, I wrote an op-ed below that explains why it hurt the very consumers it’s supposed to protect.


Senator Katie Boyd Britt (@SenKatieBritt)

The CFPB has become a tool for partisan agendas, hurting the very consumers it claims to protect. Read my @AmerBanker column on why Congress must act to rein in this unchecked agency 📖🏦
americanbanker.com/opinion/c…




— https://nitter.net/SenKatieBritt/status/1846945706113691648#m

Huge news today. Thank you to @RussVought47 for rolling back the Biden Administration’s disastrous CFPB 1071 rule.

I fought for years against the Biden Administration’s 1071 rule, including through my PROTECTED Act, because it was far-reaching, imposed significant costs, and unfairly hurt our smallest community banks that serve rural and underserved communities. This new rule ensures small lenders can continue to meet the needs of Main Street businesses, and I’m proud to be a strong supporter.

Grateful to @HawleyMO for his leadership on the GUARD Act, legislation to put critical safeguards in place for AI chatbots for minors. I’m proud we took this important step forward today in advancing this commonsense legislation to protect America’s youth. Let’s get it signed into law.

Video

Proud to see @UofAlabama leading the way with Alabama’s first School of Data Science.

As technology continues to rapidly evolve, it’s abundantly clear that we need to prepare the next generation of students for the future of AI, research, and innovation.


The University of Alabama (@UofAlabama)

The University of Alabama will pursue the establishment of the School of Data Science → the first academic unit of its kind in the state focused on artificial intelligence & one of the first dedica
Coffee with Katie is one of my favorite ways to connect with and hear directly from the people I serve in the great state of Alabama!

Proud to advance Kevin Warsh, @POTUS’s Federal Reserve Chair nominee, from the Senate Banking Committee today. Trust in our government agencies is imperative, and I believe Kevin will restore critical transparency and accountability at the Fed. Looking forward to voting to confirm his nomination.

Senate Barber shop. Then get yourself the best cup of coffee on the Hill at Cups right after.


Jacob Wasserman (@jacob_wass)

Where is a good place a young professional like myself can get a haircut in DC?

.@NASA_Marshall is at the center of our nation’s deep space exploration capabilities. Grateful to hear @NASAAdmin’s commitment to fully implementing the nuclear thermal propulsion funding appropriated by Congress so America can continue to lead in developing this technology and capability.

Video

Great to congratulate @NASAAdmin in person on a successful Artemis II mission. The work at @NASA and @NASA_Marshall is inspiring our entire nation and importantly, the next generation.

Video

Brown University’s total failure to protect its students is a decade long result of actively dismantling every layer of protection. Ella Cook, Mukhammad Aziz Umorzokov, and Nuno Loureiro should still be here with us. The other nine victims shouldn’t have been wounded. 

I believe that Brown University has violated the Clery Act, and should be held accountable to the fullest extent of the law. Thank you, @EDSecMcMahon, for not allowing Brown to brush this under the rug.

Video

We are on day 72 of Democrats’ DHS shutdown.

And next week, many of them will fly across the globe after voting for over two months against funding the agency that keeps our nation and secure. Their top priority is obstruction—not the American people.

Video

This about the safety and security of not just President Trump, but ALL future presidents. 

Build the ballroom.
